Campus 79 networking dependency: PeerJS 1.5.5, https://www.npmjs.com/package/peerjs and https://github.com/peers/peerjs . MIT license bundled at ../vendor/peerjs-LICENSE.txt. Browser direct rooms use the public PeerJS signaling service, plus Cloudflare and Google STUN; no TURN relay or availability guarantee. No microphone is enabled automatically.
